question: What is the meaning of acidification in relation to environmental performance?
description: Acidification refers to the potential of a material or process to increase the acidity of the environment, which can have negative impacts on ecosystems and human health. In the context of environmental performance indicators, acidification potential is a measure of the potential of a material or process to contribute to acid rain or other forms of environmental acidification. This is an important consideration in sustainable construction, as materials with lower acidification potential can help reduce the environmental impacts of buildings.
